title: Neural Closed-Loop Identification of Nonlinear Systems with Stability and Generalization Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.27970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks are expressive models of nonlinear dynamics, but identifying such systems from closed-loop data raises two difficulties: the feedback loop correlates inputs with measurement noise, biasing standard open-loop estimators, and the identified model must be stabilized by the data-collection controller, so that its closed-loop behavior matches the true plant's. We derive a complete parameterization of all nonlinear systems stabilized by a given controller, generalizing the classical dual-Youla parameterization to the nonlinear setting. Building on this characterization, we propose Internal Controller Identification (ICI), a computationally tractable framework for identifying potentially unstable systems while ensuring closed-loop stability by construction; in the linear case, our indirect method reduces to an open-loop identification problem, for which standard consistency results apply. translated_title: 具有稳定性与泛化保证的非线性系统神经闭环辨识
translated_abstract: 神经网络是非线性动力学的强表达能力模型，但从闭环数据中辨识此类系统面临两个困难：反馈回路使得输入与测量噪声相关，从而使标准的开环估计方法产生偏差；同时辨识出的模型必须能被数据采集控制器镇定，使其闭环行为与真实被控对象相匹配。我们推导出了由给定控制器镇定的所有非线性系统的完整参数化方法，将经典的对偶Youla参数化推广到了非线性情形。基于这一刻画，我们提出了内部控制器辨识，这是一个计算上易于处理的框架，可用于辨识可能不稳定的系统，同时通过构造方式保证闭环稳定性；在线性情形下，我们的间接方法可退化为一个开环辨识问题，因而标准的一致性结果依然适用。该框架可适应上下文相关的……
tldr: 该论文将对偶Youla参数化推广到非线性系统，提出内部控制器辨识框架，能够从闭环数据中辨识可能不稳定的非线性系统并保证闭环稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes the dual-Youla parameterization to nonlinear systems and proposes Internal Controller Identification (ICI), a tractable framework that identifies potentially unstable nonlinear systems from closed-loop data with guaranteed closed-loop stability.
